name: Macron Direct3D 9 frame-rate probe
notes: A small Direct3D 9 program from scenarios/d3d9-fps-probe that draws a 2D scene of a few hundred alpha-blended sprites, one draw each, without vsync, and prints its frame rate. Its profile is the default one (dxmt tree: Wine's builtin d3d9 on wined3d's OpenGL renderer), the path a game without a profile such as Ultimate Custom Night takes; MACRON_BACKEND, WINE_D3D_CONFIG and MACRON_OPENGL compare the others.
